//: The source generator in src/SourceGeneration is built against Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 5.9.0, so the SDK that consumes it must ship a compiler at least that new. Pinning 10.0.101 with rollForward disabled selected a 5.0.0.0 compiler, which cannot load the generated analyzer and fails the build with CS9057. latestMinor keeps builds reproducible across machines while allowing an SDK new enough to load it.
